aggregate_authorization_algorithm: AUTHORIZED only if every mandatory gate is PASS, no critical or major blocking condition remains, no constitutional conflict exists, all evidence mappings are present, freeze manifest is complete, repository validation succeeds, implementation scope is bounded, and remaining prohibitions are explicit. Mandatory FAIL or BLOCKED produces NOT_AUTHORIZED. Unresolved constitutional ambiguity produces REQUIRES_CONSTITUTIONAL_REVIEW.

gates.verification_procedure: run Phase 1 validator and focused tests
gates.pass_condition: Phase 1 validator/test pass and certification reference exists
gates.result_rationale: Phase 1 artifacts and validator are present and passed preflight.

gates.verification_procedure: run Phase 2 validator and focused tests
gates.pass_condition: Phase 2 validator/test pass and certification reference exists
gates.result_rationale: Phase 2 artifacts and validator are present and passed preflight.

gates.verification_procedure: run Phase 3 validator and focused tests
gates.pass_condition: Phase 3 validator/test pass and certification reference exists
gates.result_rationale: Phase 3 artifacts and validator are present and passed preflight.

gates.purpose: Verify BDL-1 decisions cover future implementation.
gates.verification_procedure: Phase 3 and Phase 5 validators inspect decision coverage
gates.pass_condition: all authorized scope maps to BDL-1
gates.result_rationale: Authorized scope maps to BDL-1 decisions.

gates.verification_procedure: Phase 3 and Phase 5 validators inspect IRS-1 references
gates.pass_condition: IRS-1 prerequisites represented
gates.result_rationale: IRS-1 is present and locked.

gates.verification_procedure: run EPL-1 validator and tests
gates.pass_condition: EPL-1 validator/test pass
gates.result_rationale: EPL-1 artifacts and validator are present and passed preflight.

gates.verification_procedure: run Phase 4 validator and tests
gates.pass_condition: Phase 4 validator/test pass and certification reference exists
gates.result_rationale: Phase 4 artifacts and validator are present and passed preflight.

gates.verification_procedure: Phase 4 and Phase 5 validators inspect ACS-1
gates.pass_condition: criteria complete and blocking statuses explicit
gates.result_rationale: ACS-1 has complete criteria with evidence links.

gates.verification_procedure: Phase 4 and Phase 5 validators inspect EM-1
gates.pass_condition: every criterion maps to EPL-1 evidence
gates.result_rationale: EM-1 maps every ACS-1 criterion to evidence.

gates.verification_procedure: Phase 4 and Phase 5 validators inspect ERP-1
gates.pass_condition: ERP-1 uses EPL-1 and creates no second evidence system
gates.fail_condition: new evidence system or missing registration plan
gates.result_rationale: ERP-1 maps Phase 4 evidence to EPL-1.

gates.verification_procedure: Phase 5 validator inspects prerequisite matrix and GFM-1
gates.pass_condition: all gates and scope items trace to governing source
gates.fail_condition: orphan gate, evidence, or scope item
gates.result_rationale: Phase 5 prerequisite and scope mappings are complete.

gates.verification_procedure: bounded status and path scan
gates.pass_condition: only authorized governance artifacts, validators, and tests are present
gates.result_rationale: Preflight status shows governance artifacts, validators, and tests only.

gates.verification_procedure: run required validators
gates.pass_condition: all required validators pass
gates.result_rationale: Pre-mutation validators passed; Phase 5 validator will enforce.

gates.verification_procedure: run focused tests
gates.pass_condition: focused tests pass
gates.result_rationale: Existing focused tests passed; Phase 5 tests will enforce.

gates.verification_procedure: Phase 5 validator checks conflict flags and scope boundaries
gates.pass_condition: no conflict or ambiguity
gates.result_rationale: No conflict found in prerequisite validators or Phase 5 artifacts.

gates.verification_procedure: IAG-1 algorithm
gates.pass_condition: blockers list empty
gates.result_rationale: No blockers recorded.

gates.verification_procedure: Phase 5 validator checks locked records
gates.pass_condition: all locked artifacts represented
gates.result_rationale: GFM-1 includes all locked artifacts.

gates.verification_procedure: Phase 5 validator checks scope traceability
gates.pass_condition: scope items trace to prior governance
gates.result_rationale: Authorized scope derives from CTB-1 capabilities and BDL-1 decisions.

gates.verification_procedure: Phase 5 validator checks prohibited surfaces
gates.pass_condition: all prohibited implementation surfaces explicit
gates.fail_condition: missing prohibition or claim of deployment/publication
gates.result_rationale: Continuing prohibitions are explicit.

gates.purpose: Verify Phase 5 can be independently certified.
gates.verification_procedure: separate read-only certification review
gates.pass_condition: ready for independent certification
gates.result_rationale: All Phase 5 certification inputs are present.
